exposure: Time period (before vs. during COVID-19 pandemic)
Morbidity (respiratory distress syndrome, sepsis, necrotic enterocolitis, jaundice)
outcome: Non-compliance/non-attendance in a neonatal follow-up program
cohort: The study included 1137 high-risk neonates from a hospital follow-up program, with data collected from parents regarding their attendance patterns before and during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: The study found that reasons for non-compliance with neonatal follow-up programs varied significantly between the pre-pandemic and COVID-19 periods, with parental perception of no necessity being primary before the pandemic and provider-related barriers and fear emerging during the pandemic, while multiple-gestation infants had higher odds of maintaining participation during COVID-19.
